name: Rain -Moment- "Battle of Minagi City
source:
— December 21

The town of Minagi, which even now retains its pastoral scenery.

The bustle of the shopping district with the year-end fast approaching.
A gunshot that suddenly tears through it.
A dead body surfacing in the river on the outskirts of town.

— The situation unfolds rapidly.

In pursuit of a single item,
soldiers (androids) from various organizations are deployed one after another.

And then,
at last, it escalates into all-out war between the organizations.

It happens in a town this small.
A battle this immense.

— Now, against the backdrop of this town,
a deadly struggle for life begins —
translation:
— 12月21日

至今还保留着田园风光的皆城町。

临近年底，商圈热闹非凡。
一声枪响，突然将其撕裂。
镇郊的河里有一具尸体浮出水面。

——事态发展迅速。

为了追求单一的单品，
来自各个组织的士兵（机器人）陆续部署。

然后，
最后，升级为各组织之间的全面战争。

事情就发生在这么小的一个小镇里。
如此浩大的战斗。

——现在，以这座小镇为背景，
一场生死攸关的斗争开始了——
